versions.label: Version 1 · Local
versions.notes: Lists, cards, drag & drop, checklists, labels, members. Data stored locally in the browser (no sync).

versions.label: Version 2 · Shared
versions.notes: Adds a shared realtime backend (Firebase Firestore): live multi-device sync via a secret board link. Original Trello-style card layout (calling as title).

versions.label: Version 3 · Card redesign
versions.notes: Cards now lead with the proposed person's name as the headline and the calling as the subtitle; 'Unassigned' placeholder when no person is set.

versions.label: Version 4 · Quick advance
versions.notes: Adds a per-card → button that moves a card to the bottom of the next stage, with an inertial glide animation.

versions.label: Version 5 · Touch drag
versions.notes: Rebuilt drag & drop on pointer events (mouse + touch): long-press to pick up on mobile, drop anywhere over a list, edge auto-scroll to cross columns. The → advance button is now always visible.

versions.label: Version 6 · Mobile drag fix
versions.notes: Drag now actually works on touch: touch drags are driven by touch events (not pointer events, which the browser cancels on scroll), the picked-up card stays in the DOM so events keep flowing, and scrolling is suppressed only while dragging. Long-press to drag, quick-swipe to scroll.

versions.label: Version 7 · Double-tap advance
versions.notes: Removed the → button. Double-tap (or double-click) a card to advance it to the next stage; single tap opens it. Cards no longer double-tap-zoom on mobile.
